description: This Java class 'TwoFactorConfigurationValidator' validates JSON input for updating two-factor authentication configuration, checking for supported parameters and data types, and throwing validation exceptions if necessary.

classes.name: TwoFactorConfigurationValidator
classes.description: A Spring component that validates JSON data for updating two-factor authentication settings, ensuring correct parameter types and presence.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for updating 2FA configuration, checking for unsupported parameters and data types, and raising validation errors if needed.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are any validation errors collected.

methods.name: validateBooleanParameter
methods.description: Validates that a boolean parameter exists and is either true or false.

methods.name: validateStringParameter
methods.description: Validates that a string parameter exists, is not blank, and does not exceed length limits.

methods.name: validateNumberParameter
methods.description: Validates that a number parameter exists and is greater than zero.
